```python
import json, itertools
from fractions import Fraction

def metrics(x, snapshot_idx, demands):
    """Return (metrics dict, loads list) computed independently."""
    loads = {e['id']: Fraction(0) for e in x['edges']}
    metrics = {}
    for c, v in zip(x['commodities'], demands):
        metrics[('demand', c['id'])] = v
        W = sum(r['weight'] for r in c['routes'])
        for r in c['routes']:
            amount = Fraction(v * r['weight'], W)
            for e in r['edges']:
                loads[e] += amount
    for n in x['nodes']:
        metrics[('ingress', n)] = sum(v for c, v in zip(x['commodities'], demands) if c['source'] == n)
        metrics[('egress', n)] = sum(v for c, v in zip(x['commodities'], demands) if c['target'] == n)
    metrics.update({('link', e): v for e, v in loads.items()})
    return metrics, loads
```
